question.text: A trader enters a short gold futures position at Rs 52,000 per 10 grams. At expiry, spot price is Rs 54,000 per 10 grams. For a 1 kg lot, the total loss is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Short futures payoff per 10gm = F - ST = 52,000 - 54,000 = -Rs 2,000 (loss). A 1 kg lot equals 100 units of 10gm quotation. Total loss = 2,000 × 100 = Rs 2,00,000. The Trap: Rs 2,000 is only the per-10gm loss. Rs 20,000 uses 10 units instead of 100. Always convert the lot size into the quotation unit before scaling. Note: An adverse move on a short futures position generates a mark-to-market loss that is debited from the trader's margin account, which can trigger a margin call if available margin is insufficient.
